title: Highest-Grossing Film Directors
desc: Directors ranked by cumulative worldwide box-office gross across their filmographies, using January 2026 data from Statista as published by Visual Capitalist. The cited example film is each director’s highest-grossing title, not their only contribution.

source.name: Visual Capitalist — Ranked: The Highest-Grossing Directors Ever (data: Statista)
source.note: All 20 directors, rank order, rounded cumulative grosses, and cited top-grossing film were checked against the full indexed article table by AllRanks on 2026-10-21. Source uses January 2026 data from Statista, rounds totals to $0.1B, and excludes 2026 releases without final box-office figures.
